companyFieldUpdates.description: Oryx Midstream is a Permian Basin crude-oil gathering, transportation and storage platform founded in 2013. Stonepeak acquired the business in 2019, and Qatar Investment Authority subsequently acquired a significant minority interest. In October 2021, Oryx contributed all of its Permian assets to Plains Oryx Permian Basin LLC; Plains operates and owns 65% of that joint venture, while Oryx Midstream Services Permian Basin LLC retains 35%. Current affirmative company and SEC evidence identifies both Stonepeak and QIA as continuing owner groups above the Oryx member, but their exact percentages and current holding vehicles are not publicly disclosed.
